title: When Does Hate Transfer? A Large-Scale Study of Cross-Lingual Hate Speech Detection
abstract: arXiv:2610.27285v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Effective detection of hate content is essential for maintaining healthy online communities, yet performance can vary substantially across languages. This work investigates a core practical question: Can training data from one language support hate-speech detection in another language with comparable performance? To answer this question, we conduct a large-scale study across 14 languages. \change{We observe consistent patterns in which certain language pairs transfer more effectively than others. Among the factors we measure, linguistic similarity is the strongest predictor of these patterns, with temporal overlap and dataset-size difference playing smaller roles. These measurable factors do not fully explain the observed patterns; a complementary qualitative analysis suggests that shared cultural cues and communicative norms may be associated with some of the remaining cases, particularly within several clusters. translated_title: 仇恨何时能迁移？跨语言仇恨言论检测的大规模研究
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.27285v1 宣布类型：cross 摘要：有效检测仇恨内容对于维护健康的在线社区至关重要，然而其性能在不同语言之间可能存在显著差异。本研究探讨了一个核心实践问题：来自一种语言的训练数据能否以相当的性能支持另一种语言的仇恨言论检测？为回答这一问题，我们在14种语言上开展了大规模研究。我们观察到一致的模式：某些语言对之间的迁移效果明显优于其他语言对。在我们测量的因素中，语言相似性是这些模式的最强预测因子，而时间重叠和数据集规模差异的作用较小。这些可测量的因素并不能完全解释所观察到的模式；一项补充性的定性分析表明，共享的文化线索和交际规范可能与部分剩余情况相关，尤其是在几个聚类内部。我们展示了这种文化……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究通过对14种语言的大规模实验发现，语言相似性是跨语言仇恨言论检测迁移效果的最强预测因子，而共享的文化线索和交际规范可能解释其余未知的迁移模式差异。
en_tdlr: Through large-scale experiments across 14 languages, this study finds that linguistic similarity is the strongest predictor of cross-lingual hate speech detection transfer, while shared cultural cues and communicative norms may explain the remaining unexplained transfer patterns.
